description: The growth actions Hustlin drafted or ran: posts, outreach, listings, ads. Each row has the draft first (what the founder decides on), then the brief it was generated from, its goalFit (how it serves the product's recorded goal, when one was set), its status, channel and outcome. Queued rows say what they are waiting for (your approval, your tap on a platform that forbids automated posting, or autopilot's scheduled run). Rows scheduled more than two weeks ago are marked stale and listed last; skip or reschedule them.

includeContent.description: Include each action's draft text (up to 4000 characters). Default true.

includeStale.description: Include queued or approved rows scheduled more than 14 days ago (marked stale). Default true; they come after live rows.

productId.description: Limit to one product. Omit for every product the caller can see.

status.description: queued (waiting for approval), approved, executing, completed, failed (includes skipped).
